page_title: SwiftBiu — Context Actions for Text, Files, OCR & Plugins on macOS + Windows

sources.entry: SwiftBiu - Text productivity tool with a customizable action bar and AI extensions. [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/swiftbiu/id6754772331?platform=mac)

summary.name: SwiftBiu
summary.one_liner: SwiftBiu is a context action tool for macOS (with Windows in preview) that lets you run translation, AI, file, and plugin actions on selected text or files.
use_cases: translate selected text without switching apps
run custom prompts on highlighted text
open links or search from selected text
format or clean up text in mail, notes, or editors
perform file actions on selected files
summary.what_it_does: SwiftBiu shows a native toolbar beside selected text in apps such as Mail, Safari, Notes, editors, and chat apps. From that toolbar you can run built-in actions for translation, search engines, link opening, clipboard helpers, and text formatting. It also offers AI rewrite, prompt-driven processing, Gemini-style actions, and text-to-image tools. Actions can alternatively be triggered with a dedicated shortcut or gesture instead of the toolbar. The page says it also handles file actions and plugins, and mentions OCR in its title.
notable: Selection toolbar appears beside selected text, with optional dedicated shortcut or gesture
Built-in AI rewrite, prompt-driven processing, and text-to-image actions
Available on the Mac App Store
caveats: Windows version is currently in preview
Pricing details are not stated in the page text
